0.description: Long-lived JVM systems, usually Spring Boot behind a relational database. Java appears in 93% of this cluster and IntelliJ IDEA in 78%, the tightest language-to-IDE pairing of any persona here. Docker (74%) and Maven (61%) point to containerised services with a standardised build. Two thirds also work with JavaScript, so this is rarely a backend-only role in practice.
responsibilities: Build and maintain Spring Boot services and REST APIs
Design relational schemas and tune queries on PostgreSQL or similar
Manage builds and dependencies through Maven or Gradle
Containerise services and ship them through CI/CD pipelines
Profile and tune JVM performance, memory, and garbage collection
Integrate with message queues and internal service ecosystems

1.description: The Microsoft stack end to end, from C# and ASP.NET Core to SQL Server. C# turns up in 96% of this cluster, ASP.NET Core in 73% and SQL Server in 79%, usually in enterprise or internal line-of-business applications. Notably, both Visual Studio (79%) and VS Code (81%) are common, and the ecosystem is broad enough that most people run both. HTML/CSS and JavaScript at ~74% show these are full-stack roles, not backend-only.
responsibilities: Build and maintain ASP.NET Core web applications and APIs
Model data and write queries against SQL Server
Implement business logic and integrations for enterprise systems
Build server-rendered or Blazor/JavaScript front-ends alongside the backend
Handle authentication, authorisation, and role-based access
Deploy and operate applications on Azure or on-premise Windows infrastructure

2.description: Equally at home in application code and in the infrastructure it runs on. The most tooling-heavy cluster in the data: Docker turns up in 88% of these profiles, the highest of any persona, alongside JavaScript (91%), Python (86%) and TypeScript (75%), often more than one language at once. This cluster also shows the strongest appetite for Rust and Go of any persona, suggesting a systems-oriented direction.
responsibilities: Build full-stack applications spanning TypeScript front-ends and Python or Node services
Containerise workloads and manage them through orchestration platforms
Design and operate CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
Provision cloud infrastructure and manage it as code
Monitor production systems, set up alerting, and handle incidents
Choose and integrate services across cloud provider ecosystems

3.description: Classic LAMP work: PHP and MySQL under a JavaScript front-end. PHP (76%) sits with MySQL (76%) or MariaDB (51%), fronted by JavaScript (92%) and HTML/CSS (86%). This persona builds and maintains content-driven sites, CMS platforms, and commercial web applications, frequently as the sole developer on a project. Node.js at 53% shows a substantial part of the cluster has already moved partway into the JavaScript ecosystem, and Python and TypeScript are the two skills its members most want to learn next.
responsibilities: Build and maintain PHP web applications, CMS platforms, and e-commerce sites
Design and query MySQL or MariaDB schemas
Implement front-end interfaces with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, and plugins
Manage shared or VPS hosting, deployments, and site performance
Handle web security basics: input validation, sessions, and access control

4.description: The only persona whose dominant role is back-end rather than full-stack. Python (90%) sits alongside Docker (75%), Bash (66%), PostgreSQL (63%), and pip (63%), a shell-and-container workflow oriented toward services, automation, and data work. JavaScript drops to 48%, the lowest of any cluster, confirming these developers spend most of their time away from the browser.
responsibilities: Build Python services, APIs, and backend business logic
Write data processing, ETL, and automation scripts
Design and query PostgreSQL schemas
Package and deploy applications with Docker and virtual environments
Automate operational tasks through shell scripting
Work with data or ML tooling and move experiments toward production

5.description: TypeScript and React on the browser, Node.js on the server. TypeScript reaches 78% of this cluster, React 68% and Node.js 67%, while npm (75%) and Docker (71%) reflect a modern package-and-container workflow. This is the JavaScript ecosystem at its current centre of gravity: typed, component-based, and full-stack by default rather than split between front-end and back-end specialists.
responsibilities: Build React front-ends with TypeScript and modern component patterns
Develop Node.js APIs and server-side rendering layers
Manage packages, bundlers, and build tooling across the JavaScript ecosystem
Implement state management, routing, and client-side data fetching
Write component and integration tests
Optimise bundle size, rendering performance, and Core Web Vitals
